text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
A stage that shows dreams to the spectators, to our current juniors,
and to the competitors of the future.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
For the sake of the ideal I'm aiming for,
this is a race I cannot afford to lose.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, nothing gets past you, does it?
I admit, I am putting a bit too much pressure on myself.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
However, my friend, don't you think it's only natural?
So many people have expectations. Among them—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Since you aspired to become a Trainer, I'm sure
you covet the title of "Derby Trainer" as well.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I understand. I just need to run
in order to make my own ideals a reality.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
At least you can take it easy.
The "Emperor," Symboli Rudolf, will—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Why don't we go give those dreamers
one hell of a thrill?
